Subject: Onboarding: legal name, remit address, PO routing details

Hi Bradley —

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, to create Acme Field Services as a vendor in our master we need a short packet: legal entity name, W-9 (or local tax equivalent), bank confirmation for ACH (if applicable), and the remittance address we'll map for PO/invoice routing.

Quick checklist:
- Legal name exactly as it should appear on invoices
- Tax ID / W-9 (PDF)
- Remit address for AP (street, city, postal code, country)
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone)
- Preferred PO acknowledgement email and any EDI/portal ID

If you can send those back today I’ll start the vendor master entry and route the PO steward assignment to Finance for approval. I’ve attached the standard onboarding checklist for your convenience (see referenced in Drive link below).

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference

Jordan —

Thanks for the packet. I reviewed the attachments. Action items and decisions:

1) Vendor record: create as Acme Field Services, Inc.
   - ERP vendor code: ACME-AFS-2026 (per current naming rules: VEND-{short}-{year})
   - Tax classification: Domestic (US) — set TAX_US = true
2) Remit vs bill-to: set Remit-To address to the AP mailbox (ap@acmefield.com) for PO acknowledgements; keep the physical remit address you received on the vendor profile for check/ach routing.
3) PO steward and GL: Karthik confirmed default GL 5400 (Operations - Field Services). Karthik, please reply here if you want a different default or multiple routing options.
4) Thresholding/tiering: set default approval threshold at $25k; for single orders >$25k route to Procurement Director for pre-approval.

I’ll create the vendor record this afternoon and tag it for Validation. Jordan — once record is live I will send the vendor code and vendor-facing instructions for PO submission and invoicing.

Marissa Cole
Senior Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

CC: Karthik Iyer
